questions.evidenceQuote: You save a few hours of free time, which presumably translates into more happiness. Ashley Whillans and colleagues found that, across 4,469 respondents, those who spent some money every month to save free time were happier than those who didn’t. specificFindings: The president-and-patent item is an example task question,not an independent patent-law assessment or prerequisite knowledge rule. The authored exercise asks its role,not an answer absent from its parent excerpt.
Wait/skip are experiment response options,not four factual answer alternatives. Skipping hides the answer and proceeds,whereas waiting permits access after a delay.

Ten-to-fifteen seconds randomisation applies specifically to the exact delay,not question count,job assignment,participant age or pay. Fifteen questions is a different unit. No unreported uniform distribution or other randomisation is added.
Typically willing to wait reflects wanting the answer and the tasks behavioural-curiosity operationalisation,not guaranteed salary,unavailable skip or lifelong patience in all circumstances.

Seemingly irrelevant is perceived topic relevance,not proof other areas are false or worthless. The generalist/specialist comparison concerns imagined roles and waiting behaviour,not permanent real-world career identity or equal knowledge.

But why introduces the authors selective-attention explanation. Deep subject knowledge and marketable skills acknowledge benefits before unintended interest narrowing; neither benefit nor cost is made an absolute all-person rule.
The Louvre/MonaLisa analogy illustrates missed other experiences,not a separate museum experiment or evidence every specialist dislikes all art.

Outsourcing examples introduce efficiency and gained time. Lawn and gutter examples are the books comparative service description,not a guarantee every professional beats every individual in all work.

The200-dollar cleaning payment is explicitly illustrative,not a current quotation,user transaction or universal required fee. Presumably marks an expected happiness link rather than certain benefit from any purchase.

Whillans4469-respondent finding is kept separate from the subsequent experiment. Less time stress and higher satisfaction are linked in that account,and in part does not establish a sole universal explanation.

The subsequent experiment aims to test causal effects.80 dollars split into40 for time saving and40 for a material purchase over different weekends is retained without adding an unstated random order or merging unrelated participant samples.

Contact was on spending days,not a three-month follow-up borrowed from another study. More positive and less negative emotions are reported relative outcomes,not zero negative feeling or measured psychological richness.

Freeing up time is explicitly the payers perspective; the at-least-not-for-the-person-paying caveat prevents inferring ideal conditions for every provider. To the extent and should retain conditional expected benefit.
The outsourcing-richness question changes dimension after possible happiness benefits. It does not itself answer the question or report new evidence absent from the current excerpt.

The side-yard patio is author/wife anecdote.9000 lowest quote and about4000 materials support the projected at-least5000 labour saving,not completed profit,current market prices or guaranteed net savings for all DIY.

Being cheap describes the narrators frugal motivation,self-deprecatingly,not proven poverty or poor completed material quality. The prior videos seemed doable is preliminary perception,not a guarantee final labour matched expectations.

All11 inherited parent English/Chinese pairs were read from compact source preview and checked for complete translations, cross-page continuity, quantity units, scope of randomisation, observational versus experimental claims and example versus actual history.

Question25 evidence stops after the precise decision sentence,retaining only its immediate video context and leaving later unassigned DIY outcomes pending. Planned-evidence guard passes and all previously published fingerprints remain unchanged.
Distractors for trivia function,response mode and patio savings were refined before review to use plausible design,unit,role and scope mistakes rather than unrelated claims.
limitations: This is a batch of ongoing whole-book work, not all gaps completed.
Stable source candidate IDs remain distinct from finalized manual sentence boundaries.
